content_hash(file) = sha256(canonical JSON bytes) so LF/CRLF checkouts hash identically; combined = sha256(utf8('fixture_set=<set>
version=<version>
seed=<seed>
corpus=<content_hash(corpus.json)>
' + concat('<example id>=<content_hash(payload)>
' in manifest order) + concat('fixture:<fixture id>=<content_hash(fixture)>
' in manifest order)))
